_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED 2026-08-06 (grid drawn over the PNG at 8x — lines land exactly on tile edges; 160x144 / 16 = 10x9 = 90 frames, no remainder). Snow auto-tile terrain for a snowy-forest floor variant; the winter counterpart to forest-autotile. LABELED: 5 complete terrains — snow-dirt, snow-ice, snow-water, snow-thicket, snow-thicket-overlay — each a 3x3 outer block with its 2x2 inner-corner block 3 columns to the right. snow-thicket ships twice, baked onto snow and as an alpha overlay for any ground. Frames 28/29 are plain snow fill variants; the rest are empty.
